meta.name: firecrawl
meta.description: Search, scrape, and interact with the web via the Firecrawl CLI. Use this skill whenever the user wants to search the web, find articles, research a topic, look something up online, scrape a webpage, grab content from a URL, get data from a website, crawl documentation, download a site, or interact with pages that need clicks or logins. Also use when they say "fetch this page", "pull the content from", "get the page at https://", or reference external websites. This provides real-time web search with full page content and interact capabilities — beyond what Claude can do natively with built-in tools. Do NOT trigger for local file operations, git commands, deployments, or code editing tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索、抓取并交互网页内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从网页获取结构化数据或进行实时搜索。
copy.tagline_en: Search, scrape, and interact with web content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract structured data from websites or perform real-time web searches.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能使用Firecrawl CLI搜索网络、抓取网页内容、与网页交互（如点击、填表），并返回优化后的Markdown。还可批量爬取、监控页面变化、解析本地文件等。
howto.when: 当用户要求搜索网络、抓取网页、与网页交互（如点击、填表）等操作，或说出“获取这个页面”等关键词时触发。

say.note: Claude将执行网络搜索并返回结果。
Claude会设置定期检查并通知变化。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can search the web, scrape page content, interact with pages (e.g., clicks, forms), and return clean Markdown. It also supports bulk crawling, page monitoring, local file parsing, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to search, scrape, interact with a page, or says "fetch this page", "pull the content from", etc.

say_en.text: Search for the latest news about AI.
say_en.note: Claude will perform a web search and return results.
Claude will scrape the URL and return Markdown.
